error_summary: 固定 64 MiB CUDA 分配超过当前进程设置的显存配额，触发 OOM。

evidence.content:
interpreter=/demo/target-env/bin/python
cwd=/demo/work/project/jobs
device_total_bytes=17074421760 quota_bytes=17074421
request_bytes=67108864
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/demo/work/project/jobs/failure_demo.py", line 16, in <module>
    torch.empty(config["request_bytes"], dtype=torch.uint8, device=config["device"])
torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 64.00 MiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 15.90 GiB of which 14.80 GiB is free. 16.28 MiB allowed; Of the allocated memory 0 bytes is allocated by PyTorch, and 0 bytes is reserved by PyTorch but unallocated. If reserved but unallocated memory is large try setting PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True to avoid fragmentation.  See documentation for Memory Management  (https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/cuda.html#environment-variables)

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print(f"interpreter={sys.executable}", flush=True)
print(f"cwd={Path.cwd()}", flush=True)
import torch

# A fixed 64 MiB request exceeds a process quota capped at 32 MiB.
total = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(config["device"]).total_memory
fraction = min(config["memory_fraction"], (32 * 1024 * 1024) / total)
torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(fraction, config["device"])
print(f"device_total_bytes={total} quota_bytes={int(total * fraction)}", flush=True)
print(f"request_bytes={config['request_bytes']}", flush=True)
torch.empty(config["request_bytes"], dtype=torch.uint8, device=config["device"])

hypotheses.cause: 代码将进程分配器配额限制到总显存的 0.1%（最多 32 MiB），再申请 64 MiB；日志记录配额及申请量。支持进程配额限制，不支持据此认定整卡耗尽、泄漏或碎片化。
pending_checks: 选择明显低于该配额的申请量，在同一配额设置下验证最小分配。
